item.title: The Journey Celebrates Another Year as Best Radio DJ’s - CMB
item.description: (Lynchburg, VA) The Morning Journey is once again Best Radio DJs in the annual Lynchburg Living Magazine Best Of edition. The online and print annual magazine asks readers to vote on different categories (Restaurants, relators, auto repair, etc.…) and the team of Mark Edwards and Brittany Minard won the top honor in the DJ category.
